description: This header file declares internal functions related to the Http Simple Server Object within a C-based HTTP implementation. It includes prototypes for functions managing interfaces, server modes, property handling, lifecycle management, session objects, request and response objects, and socket-related operations.

methods.name: HttpSsoGetWspIf
methods.description: Retrieves the WSP interface associated with the Http Simple Server Object.

methods.name: HttpSsoSetWspIf
methods.description: Sets the WSP interface for the Http Simple Server Object.

methods.name: HttpSsoGetHfpIf
methods.description: Retrieves the HFP interface.

methods.name: HttpSsoSetHfpIf
methods.description: Sets the HFP interface.

methods.name: HttpSsoGetFumIf
methods.description: Retrieves the FUM interface.

methods.name: HttpSsoSetFumIf
methods.description: Sets the FUM interface.

methods.name: HttpSsoGetServerMode
methods.description: Gets the current server mode as an unsigned long.

methods.name: HttpSsoSetServerMode
methods.description: Sets the server mode.

methods.name: HttpSsoGetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the properties of the Http Simple Server Object.

methods.name: HttpSsoSetProperty
methods.description: Sets the properties of the Http Simple Server Object.

methods.name: HttpSsoResetProperty
methods.description: Resets the properties to default values.

methods.name: HttpSsoReset
methods.description: Resets the Http Simple Server Object to initial state.

methods.name: HttpSsoEngage
methods.description: Engages or activates the Http Simple Server Object.

methods.name: HttpSsoCancel
methods.description: Cancels or deactivates the Http Simple Server Object.

methods.name: HttpSsoWorkerInit
methods.description: Initializes worker resources.

methods.name: HttpSsoWorkerUnload
methods.description: Unloads or cleans up worker resources.

methods.name: HttpSsoAcquireWsso
methods.description: Acquires a WebSocket Session Object instance.

methods.name: HttpSsoReleaseWsso
methods.description: Releases a WebSocket Session Object instance.

methods.name: HttpSsoManufactureWssoPool
methods.description: Creates a pool of WebSocket Session Object instances.

methods.name: HttpSsoDestroyWssoPool
methods.description: Destroys the WebSocket Session Object pool.

methods.name: HttpSsoAcquireWsto
methods.description: Acquires a WebSocket Transport Object.

methods.name: HttpSsoReleaseWsto
methods.description: Releases a WebSocket Transport Object.

methods.name: HttpSsoManufactureWstoPool
methods.description: Creates a pool of WebSocket Transport Objects.

methods.name: HttpSsoDestroyWstoPool
methods.description: Destroys the WebSocket Transport Object pool.

methods.name: HttpSsoAcquireBmoReq
methods.description: Acquires a Request Message Object.

methods.name: HttpSsoReleaseBmoReq
methods.description: Releases a Request Message Object.

methods.name: HttpSsoManufactureBmoReqPool
methods.description: Creates a pool of Request Message Objects.

methods.name: HttpSsoDestroyBmoReqPool
methods.description: Destroys the Request Message Object pool.

methods.name: HttpSsoAcquireBmoRep
methods.description: Acquires a Response Message Object.

methods.name: HttpSsoReleaseBmoRep
methods.description: Releases a Response Message Object.

methods.name: HttpSsoManufactureBmoRepPool
methods.description: Creates a pool of Response Message Objects.

methods.name: HttpSsoDestroyBmoRepPool
methods.description: Destroys the Response Message Object pool.

methods.name: HttpSsoWspAccept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming WebSocket Protocol connection.

methods.name: HttpSsoWspServe
methods.description: Serves a WebSocket session.

methods.name: HttpSsoDstowoAccept
methods.description: Accepts a socket connection for HTTP.

methods.name: HttpSsoDstowoSetOut
methods.description: Sets output destination for socket connection.

methods.name: HttpSsoDstowoRemove
methods.description: Removes a socket connection.

methods.name: HttpSsoDstowoQuery
methods.description: Queries the socket for data.

methods.name: HttpSsoDstowoProcessSync
methods.description: Processes socket data synchronously.

methods.name: HttpSsoDstowoProcessAsync
methods.description: Processes socket data asynchronously.

methods.name: HttpSsoDstowoSendComplete
methods.description: Notifies completion of send operation.

methods.name: HttpSsoDstowoNotify
methods.description: Handles socket events.
